value.rationale: This is a naturally complete finite classification of a canonical area-weighted random convex polygon, with rational formulas for arbitrary positive directional intensities. It separates an origin-containing zero-cell statistic from widely studied typical-cell statistics; the equal-weight hexagon probability is 49/432, more than four times 1/36, showing quantitative geometric size bias. It is not a single arbitrary numeric slice or known-table recomputation.
